dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いいたします時間になったら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. We can begin now that it's our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。初めにご年齢、性別、呼ばせていただいてよいお名前を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and the name you'd like me to call you?

dialogue.content: 死にたい
dialogue.English: I want to die.

dialogue.content: 死んでもいいよね
dialogue.English: It's okay if I die, right?

dialogue.content: 生きてても意味ないし
dialogue.English: There's no point in living anyway.

dialogue.content: 折角お話に来てくださっているので何があったのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Since you've taken the time to come and talk, would you be willing to tell me what's been going on?

dialogue.content: 何が、、
dialogue.English: What…?

dialogue.content: わかんない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: とにかく死にたい
dialogue.English: I just want to die.

dialogue.content: ここに来ていただいている間少し私とお話することはできますか？
dialogue.English: While you're here, would you be able to talk with me for a little while?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お名前なんとお呼びしたらいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like me to call you?

dialogue.content: りん
dialogue.English: Rin.

dialogue.content: りんさんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Rin, I see. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんな私が生きていてごめんなさい
dialogue.English: I'm sorry that someone like me is alive.

dialogue.content: りんさん、生きていたらダメな人なんていませんよ。
dialogue.English: Rin, there is no one who doesn't deserve to be alive.

dialogue.content: 死んでいればよかったのに
dialogue.English: I wish I had died.

dialogue.content: 何か生命に危機が及ぶようなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: Has anything happened that put your life at risk?

dialogue.content: 毎日死にたいと思ってます
dialogue.English: I think about wanting to die every day.

dialogue.content: そう感じておられるのは、毎日お辛いんですね。
dialogue.English: Feeling that way every day must be very hard for you.

dialogue.content: どうなれば気持ちが少しでも晴れる気がしますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think might help lift your spirits, even a little?

dialogue.content: 気持ちが晴れたことなんてないからわからない
dialogue.English: I've never felt my spirits lift, so I don't know.

dialogue.content: そう感じられるようになったのはいつ頃からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: About when did you start to feel that way?

dialogue.content: ずっと前から
dialogue.English: For a long time.

dialogue.content: ずっと前とは子供のころから？思春期の頃からですか？
dialogue.English: By "a long time," do you mean since you were a child? Or during your adolescence?

dialogue.content: なんて読むんですか？
dialogue.English: How do you read that?

dialogue.content: わかんない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 子どものころからつらく感じているのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you been feeling this pain since you were a child?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は何才になられますか？
dialogue.English: How old are you now?

dialogue.content: １４さいなんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: You’re 14, I see. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 中学生ですか？
dialogue.English: Are you in middle school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。お友達にそういう気持ちを言ってみたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you ever tried talking with your friends about these feelings?

dialogue.content: ない
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: それで今日は私にそうだんしてくれているんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: So that's why you're talking with me today. Thank you for doing so.

dialogue.content: 死にたい
dialogue.English: I want to die.

dialogue.content: 今手首切りました
dialogue.English: I just cut my wrist.

dialogue.content: だいじょうぶですか？話せますか？周りにだれかいますか？
dialogue.English: Are you okay? Can you still talk? Is there anyone else with you?

dialogue.content: 周りに誰もいない
dialogue.English: There's no one around.

dialogue.content: 今は家ですか？きもちわるくなっていないですか？
dialogue.English: Are you at home right now? Are you feeling sick at all?

dialogue.content: 家
dialogue.English: Home.

dialogue.content: わかりました。どれぐらい血は出てますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. How much are you bleeding?

dialogue.content: そんなに深くない
dialogue.English: It's not that deep.

dialogue.content: 血は自然に止まりそうですか？
dialogue.English: Does it look like the bleeding will stop on its own?

dialogue.content: さあ
dialogue.English: I’m not sure.

dialogue.content: 気分が悪くなったり、会話できなくなってきそうなら早めに教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: If you start to feel sick or find it hard to talk, can you let me know as soon as possible?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: このまま死ねたらいいのに
dialogue.English: I wish I could just die like this.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。少し私とお話しませんか？
dialogue.English: Please. Would you talk with me a bit?

dialogue.content: なに？
dialogue.English: About what?

dialogue.content: 私に聞いてほしいこととかありますか？どんなことでもいいのでりんさんのことを教えてください
dialogue.English: Is there anything you want me to listen to? It can be anything at all. Please tell me about yourself, Rin.

dialogue.content: どうやったら楽に死ねるかな
dialogue.English: I wonder what the easiest way to die is.

dialogue.content: これまでODとかもしたけど死ねないの
dialogue.English: I've tried to OD before, but I couldn't die.

dialogue.content: 残念ながら楽に死ねる方法はありませんよ。それよりご自分をの気持ちを救う方法をかんがえていきませんか？
dialogue.English: Unfortunately, there is no easy way to die. Instead of that, why don't we think about ways to help you feel better?

dialogue.content: それより‥
dialogue.English: Rather than that…

dialogue.content: 言葉がすぎたらごめんなさい。でも今日ここに相談に来てくださったのは、だれかに気持ちを聞いてほしいとか、わかってほしいからではないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if I overstepped. But isn't the reason you came to talk today because you wanted someone to listen to your feelings, to understand you?

dialogue.content: そうだね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: でもきっと分かってもらえない
dialogue.English: But I'm sure I won't be understood.

dialogue.content: それはやってみないとわからなくないかな？よければ気持ちとか、思いつくことを書いてみてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: We won't know unless we try, will we? If you'd like, could you try writing down your feelings, or anything that comes to mind?

dialogue.content: 死にたい
dialogue.English: I want to die.

dialogue.content: それは何度か教えてくれたね。他には？
dialogue.English: You've told me that a few times. Anything else?

dialogue.content: ちょっとしんどくなってきた
dialogue.English: I'm starting to feel a bit overwhelmed.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんもうんざりしてるもんね
dialogue.English: You must be fed up with me too, right?

dialogue.content: ごめんねちゃんと話せなくて
dialogue.English: I’m sorry I can’t talk properly.

dialogue.content: いつもこうなんだよ
dialogue.English: It’s always like this.

dialogue.content: 迷惑かけちゃうから
dialogue.English: Because I just end up causing trouble.

dialogue.content: 死んだほうがいいんだよ
dialogue.English: It would be better if I died.

dialogue.content: そんなことないですよ。ちゃんと話す必要はないですよ。単語でいいので思いつくことをかけますか？そばで聞いて上げられたらいいんだけど、残念ながらそれは出来ないので、ここに書いてもらえると助かります。りんさんのこと少しでも知りたいです。
dialogue.English: That's not true. You don't have to speak perfectly. Can you write down anything that comes to mind, even just single words? I wish I could be there to listen to you in person, but unfortunately I can't, so it would help if you could write it here. I want to understand you, even just a little.

dialogue.content: 何を書けばいいか分からないの😭
dialogue.English: I don’t know what to write. 😭

dialogue.content: 死んじゃったらどうなると思う？
dialogue.English: What do you think happens when you die?

dialogue.content: 何もなくなりますよ。でも生き返った人はいないのでわからないです。こわくないですか？
dialogue.English: Everything will be gone. But no one has ever come back to life, so we don't really know. Isn't that scary?

dialogue.content: こわい？
dialogue.English: Scared?

dialogue.content: わたしは楽になれると思うな
dialogue.English: I think I'll finally be at peace.

dialogue.content: わたしはこわいです。健康な体なのに死ぬのは相当な苦痛を伴うと思うので、わたしこわいですね。
dialogue.English: I think it's scary. I believe dying when you have a healthy body would involve a great deal of pain, so yes, it's scary to me.

dialogue.content: なんでそんなこというの
dialogue.English: Why would you say that?

dialogue.content: そういうこととはどういうことですか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by “that”?

dialogue.content: 死ぬのがこわいとか、くるしいとか
dialogue.English: Like that dying is scary, or painful.

dialogue.content: ODすればいいか
dialogue.English: Maybe I should just OD.

dialogue.content: 死んでる人いたよね
dialogue.English: There have been people who died from it, right?

dialogue.content: わたしだけではなく普通そう思うとおもいますよ。ODも死にきれなくて後遺症が残るとかあるかもしれないし、そういうことまで考えたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: It’s not just me—I think most people feel that way. With an OD, you might not die and could be left with lasting effects; have you thought about things like that?

dialogue.content: 普通ってなに？
dialogue.English: What is "normal"?

dialogue.content: 私は普通じゃないってことか
dialogue.English: Does that mean I'm not normal?

dialogue.content: たしかに
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: りんさん、そういうつもりで言ったのではないのです。気をわるくしたらごめんなさい。動物は本来死を怖がるようにできているんです。そうでないと人類も今存在している地球上の生物も、自然淘汰されて今いないはずです。普通とは本来という意味で、りんさんが違うという意味ではないです
dialogue.English: Rin, that's not what I meant. I'm sorry if I offended you. Animals are inherently programmed to fear death. If that weren't the case, humanity and all other living things on Earth would have been weeded out by natural selection and wouldn't exist now. When I said "normal," I meant it in the sense of "innate," not that you are different.

dialogue.content: むずかしいわ
dialogue.English: That’s hard to understand.

dialogue.content: バカだから仕方ない
dialogue.English: I can’t help it, I’m stupid.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。そんなことはないですよ。りんさんが死にこだわる理由はいろいろあるんだと思います。でも今できることを先にやってみてほしいと思っています。すきなこととかは何ですか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry. That's not true at all. I'm sure there are many reasons you're preoccupied with death. But I'd like you to try doing what you can right now first. What are some things you like?

dialogue.content: 好きなことはスマホで死ぬ方法を検索すること
dialogue.English: The thing I like to do is search for ways to die on my phone.

dialogue.content: 他にもありませんか？食べ物はなにがすきですか？お母さんの手料理はなにがおいしいですか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else? What kind of food do you like? What's your favorite dish that your mother cooks?

dialogue.content: お母さんの手料理なんか！食べてない!もぅいいです！
dialogue.English: My mother's cooking! I don't eat it! That's enough!

dialogue.content: さようなら！
dialogue.English: Goodbye!

dialogue.content: うまく気持ちわかってあげられなくてごめんなさい。今日初めて会話したんですもんね。もしよかったらまた相談に来てください。今日はありがとうございました。終了時間が来てるので、今日は終了していいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry I wasn't able to understand your feelings well. This was our first time talking, after all. If you'd like, please come back for another session. Thank you for today. Our time is up, so may I end the session for today?

dialogue.content: （大丈夫です。）
dialogue.English: (That’s fine.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ヘビーな内容ですみません。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. Sorry for the heavy content.)

dialogue.content: では終了させていただきます。（いえいえ、今日は練習にお付き合いいただき、ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: Then I will end the session now. (Not at all, thank you for joining me for this practice session today.)
